CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   C. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   D. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   D. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   B. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   D. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

15. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   B. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit 3.2 The Gifts of the Holy Spirit 3.3 The Holy Trinity 3.4 Sacram and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Gifts of the Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Trinity 3.4 Sacraments 4.0 Christian Living Today 4.1 Christian Ethics  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Trinity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Sacraments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
